recreation_brief:
1. Set the slide background to solid light beige (#F5E6D3).
2. Place the title text "Neural Network Model" at the top center; format as bold, dark red (#8B0000), approximately 40pt, sans-serif.
3. Place the subtitle text "(Weights of hidden layer AFFECT Calculated Error)" directly below the title, top center; format as dark blue/purple (#8B008B), approximately 24pt, sans-serif.
4. Place a yellow circle (#FFD700) in the top-right corner containing the number "15".
5. Place a rounded rectangle in the top-left corner: fill light purple (#E6CCFF), border purple (#8B008B), text "Input Sample".
6. Place a rounded rectangle in the top-right corner: fill light purple (#E6CCFF), border purple (#8B008B), text "Target Label".
7. Place 3 white circles (#FFFFFF) with black borders in the left column (input layer); label each with a black Σ symbol.
8. Place 3 green circles (#90EE90) with black borders in the center column (hidden layer); label each with a black Σ symbol.
9. Place 3 orange circles (#FFA07A) with black borders in the right column (output layer); label each with a black Σ symbol.
10. Draw black arrows from each input node to each hidden node; label the connections "w_ji".
11. Draw black arrows from each hidden node to each output node; label the connections "w_kj".
12. Place a square activation box labeled "f" between each output node and its corresponding output label (3 boxes total).
13. Place orange rectangles (#FFA07A fill, #FF4500 border) to the right of the output nodes labeled "Output 1", "Output 2", and "Output m".
14. Draw a dashed black curved arrow from the output layer back toward the input layer to represent error feedback.
15. Place 3 small purple dots (#DDA0DD) on the far left as bias inputs.
16. Place the text "Node Bias" near the purple dots with a circled "1".
17. Place a vertical dark red rectangle (#8B0000) along the far right edge; add white rotated text "Error Error" inside it.
18. Place 3 green rectangles (#90EE90 fill, #006400 border) to the left of the error bar labeled "Class 1", "Class 2", and "Class m".
19. Place a pink rounded rectangle (#FFB6C1) at the bottom center labeled 'For Layer "j"'.
20. Place a blue rounded rectangle (#87CEFA) at the bottom center labeled 'Previous Layer (l)'.
21. Place a green rounded rectangle (#90EE90) at the bottom center labeled 'Current Layer (You are here)'.
22. Place an orange rounded rectangle (#FFA07A) at the bottom center labeled 'Next Layer (K)'.
23. Place a pink rounded rectangle (#FFB6C1) at the bottom center labeled 'Note: Layer "j" is NOT Output Layer'.
24. Place a white equation box (#FFFFFF fill, #000000 border) in the bottom-left containing two lines: "Net_j = Σ (w_ji , O_i)" and "O_j = f(Net_j) = 1 / (1 + e^-Net_j)".
25. Place a white equation box (#FFFFFF fill, #000000 border) in the bottom-right containing "E = 1/2 Σ_j (t_j - O_j)^2" followed by red text "X X X" (#FF0000).
26. Place small labels "Net_j" and "O_j" adjacent to the hidden layer nodes, and "Net_k" and "O_k" adjacent to the output layer nodes.
27. Place small upward-pointing arrows labeled "i", "j", and "k" beneath the bottom annotation boxes, aligning with the input, hidden, and output layers respectively.
